insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident (eligibility certificate under Surrogacy Act 2021)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Personal waiting periods up to 36 months for declared conditions. Surrogacy attempts not more than 3 times in policy period. Oocyte donor: only one retrieval per policy period.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent 1% of SI per day; ICU/ICCU up to actuals (subject to SI); covers surrogate pregnancy/post-partum complications OR oocyte donor complications
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Choose either D1 Surrogate Cover OR D2 Oocyte Donor Cover (not both).

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care procedures connected to pregnancy/post-partum or oocyte retrieval complications

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Surrogacy: covers complications arising from pregnancy and post-partum delivery (excessive bleeding, infections, breast issues, perineal pain, gestational diabetes, lawful termination, etc.)
maternity_coverage.notes: Per Surrogacy (Regulation) Act 2021. Up to 3 surrogacy attempts. Eligibility certificate required.

newborn_coverage.notes: Policy is for surrogate mother / oocyte donor, not newborn.

temporary_exclusions: Personal waiting periods up to 36 months for declared conditions
notable_exclusions_summary: Surrosafe is a specialised cover for surrogate mothers and oocyte donors under the Surrogacy (Regulation) Act 2022. Excludes treatments outside India, OPD, congenital external anomalies, infertility treatments (different from cover), and preventive care. Limited to pregnancy/post-partum complications (surrogate cover) OR oocyte retrieval complications (donor cover).
claim_process_summary: Claims via TPA. Cashless at network hospitals; reimbursement via document submission. Settled within 15 days of last document with 2% above bank rate penal interest for delays.
